description: Use this when someone asks which stylists or hairdressers work at their salon or can be booked. Returns up to 100 hairdresser display names from the organization that owns the salon (no contact details or schedules). Not for stylists' days off.

salonId.description: Id of one of the user's salons, as the salon list returns it (24 lowercase hex characters)

name: list_providers

providers.description: Display names of organization members with the hairdresser role; roles are organization-wide, not per salon. Staff ids, contact details, avatar URLs, role records, schedules and organization data are excluded.

title: List stylists who take appointments
